headline: Nigeria's NCGC Backs ₦64 Billion in Loans During First Year of Operations
summary: The National Credit Guarantee Company in Nigeria has guaranteed ₦64.13 billion in loans and supported over 150,000 direct and indirect jobs in its inaugural operational year.
why: State-backed credit guarantee institutions are essential for expanding commercial lending to Nigerian small businesses facing tight liquidity.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking
impacts.why: Credit guarantees reduce default risk for financial institutions lending to small enterprises.
